main_text.l: Iudic. 6.v. 19. Ruth. 2.17. Hæc fuit communissima & no-
tissima Hebræorum mensura, & quasi reliquarum men-
surarum mensura, quæ tantum capiebat in aridis, quantum
in liquidis bathus. 5. Letech, siue Semicorus, 5.epha-
rum. Hos.3.v.2. 6. Corus, siue Chomer, amplissima arido-
rum mensura, 10.epharum. 1.Reg. 4.verf. 22.cap. 5.ver. 11.

rum in sacris, hoc ordine. 1.Logus, mensura minima, e-

it.14. 2. Hin, sexta pars bathi, capiens 12.logos. Exod.29.

in aridis. Fuit 72.logorum, (u limidiæ[?] ohmæ nostratis.

page.notes: Right margin numbers 10, 15, 20, 25, 30 and 35 are line numbers, placed at their lines. "Hos." is printed "Hof." (long s). The word after "(u" is unclear. "drei Quintlein" is black letter and partly unclear. "Quintlein" is uncertain. The position of "Logus" and "Hin" as italic is approximate. The gloss at the foot is indented and in the same type size as the text; it is kept as a foot paragraph. The "15" line-number is marked in the text as "thaleros".
